canada.summary: One week into the term of Mississauga's new mayor and hiring restrictions are going into effect at the city. It comes after staff were directed by Mayor Alvin Tedjo to freeze property taxes for the 2027 and 2028 budgets.

canada.title: Police probing city hall corruption filed ‘inaccurate' info, says former mayor now asking for unsealed docs

canada.title: Spike in emissions a major setback in GTA climate goals: report

canada.summary: PAL Airlines and CUPE, which represents some 150 flight attendants, have reached a tentative agreement but it will still need to be ratified. The airline is still in negotiations with its pilots, who are represented by the Air Line Pilots Association.

canada.title: Emissions are another reason for an environmental review of EverWind’s hyperscale data centre

canada.title: After 15 years and 2 fires, Beauval, Sask., receives funding for new community complex
